# Base Price vs Discount Percent
plt.figure(figsize = (10, 5))
sns.scatterplot(data = df.head(15), x = "base_price", y = "discount_percent", hue = "state")
plt.title("Base Price vs Discount Percent", fontsize = 14, fontweight = "bold")
plt.xlabel("base_price", fontsize = 12)
plt.ylabel("discount_percent", fontsize = 12)
plt.show()
In [18]:
# Top Revenue Category
top_category = df.groupby("category")["revenue"].sum().sort_values(ascending = False)
top_category.plot(kind = "bar", figsize = (10, 5), edgecolor = "black", color = sns.color_palette("rainbow"))
plt.title("Category vs Revenue", fontsize = 14, fontweight = "bold")
plt.xlabel("category", fontsize = 12)
plt.ylabel("revenue", fontsize = 12)
plt.grid(axis = "y")
plt.show()

In [23]:
# Monthly Wise Revenue Trend
df["order_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["order_date"])
monthly_revenue = df.groupby(df["order_date"].dt.to_period("M"))["revenue"].sum()
monthly_revenue.index = monthly_revenue.index.astype(str)
monthly_revenue.plot(kind = "line", marker = "o", figsize = (10, 5), color = "red")
plt.title("Monthly Wise Revenue Trend", fontsize = 14, fontweight = "bold")
plt.xlabel("Month", fontsize = 12)
plt.ylabel("Revenue", fontsize = 12)
plt.grid(True)
plt.xticks(rotation = 45)
plt.show()
